## Summary

Dardan Demiri builds production web applications, e-commerce platforms, content-driven websites, internal tools, learning platforms, and custom business software. He has 5+ years of experience designing, building, and scaling customer-facing web applications across e-commerce, education technology, restaurant/service businesses, and small-business operations.

## Featured work

- Drenova Group Real Estate Platform: Built a real-estate platform for GTA/York Region with Sanity CMS, AMPRE/MLS listing sync, Redis-backed listing cache, lead capture workflows, listing inquiry forms, ISR revalidation, and compliance-aware address suppression. Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, Sanity, GROQ, Redis, AMPRE/MLS, Resend, Playwright. Live site: https://drenova.ca
- Aira Publishing Platform: Built an education publishing platform connecting CMS content, checkout, Helcim payment validation, Schoology fulfillment, credential delivery, admin operations, audit logging, and Playwright-tested storefront/admin flows. Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, Sanity, PostgreSQL, Helcim, Schoology, Resend, Playwright. Live site: https://airapublishing.com
- Lash Her Booking and Commerce Platform: A booking and commerce platform for a beauty-services business, integrating CMS-managed content, Google Calendar availability, Helcim checkout, Redis idempotency, PostgreSQL order storage, and Resend confirmation emails. Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, Sanity, Google Calendar, Helcim, PostgreSQL, Redis, Resend. Live site: https://lashher.com
- Danny’s Fish & Chips Restaurant Platform: A production CMS-backed restaurant platform with Strapi-managed menus, specials, announcements, gallery content, contact forms, mailing-list signup, CI/CD, and Playwright preview testing. Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, Strapi, Tailwind CSS, Resend, Vercel, Railway, GitHub Actions. Live site: https://dannysfishandchips.com
- PLP — Personalized Learning Plan: A private education platform for Scholarly Elite Tutoring that manages personalized curriculum trees, admin and creator workflows, file attachments, asynchronous PDF/ZIP exports, API documentation, and tested Rails/React workflows. Technologies: Ruby on Rails, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, ActiveStorage, RSpec.
